notes: detrend name factory over regression models (Linear, Poisson, Tweedie, Gamma, TheilSen, RANSAC, ARD, ElasticNet, ...); each newly offered detrend model forces a new arm.

subject: candidate_name
notes: candidate_name dispatch over trading strategy names (maxdiff, maxdiffalwayson, all_signals) deciding position side; each new strategy needs its own arm here.

subject: img
notes: isinstance over accepted image forms (base64 str, bytes, PIL Image): input normalisation, closed.

subject: element_type
notes: Scalar element type prefixes (float to vec, int to ivec, uint to uvec) fixed by the shading language's vector type naming; closed by specification.

subject: view.d.conflict_type
notes: conflict_type values are the fixed UCDP conflict categories of this one dataset export (all, intrastate, interstate, non-state); closed by the dataset definition.

subject: content_block.type
notes: match over content block types of the external Anthropic messages API (text, tool_use, mcp_tool_use, ...), fixed by that specification; closed.

subject: out_layout
notes: out_layout dispatch over named tensor layouts (NHWT, NTHW, NTCHW, NTHWC, TNHW, TNCHW) mirrored by an in_layout chain; each new layout forces arms in both chains.
